statement: S1579's nine kernel-pair relations (equivalent, isomorphic, refinement, projection, conservative extension, reformulation, competing model, inconsistent, incomparable) are not pairwise exclusive as stated (isomorphic vs equivalent vs reformulation overlap; a conservative extension is a kind of refinement in the usual sense; 'competing model' can coincide with 'inconsistent' or 'incomparable'), and 'classify every pair into one of' presupposes a partition. The mandated bidirectional test ('Can every structure required by A be constructed from B? and conversely') induces two Boolean judgements per pair, i.e. a researcher-constructable preorder A ⊑ B (A reconstructible from B) whose symmetric part would give equivalence; most of the nine classes could be read as refinements of the four outcomes of (A⊑B, B⊑A) plus a consistency judgement. The corpus's reconciliation vocabulary also differs from the P3a pair vocabulary (e.g. EXTENSION), which this record notes without proposing any change.

supporting_evidence.anchor: 3. Determine the relationship between the kernels
